name: Alexandra Dantes
source:
Alex rarely offers reassurance without attaching a joke to it. Strong, competitive, and hard to embarrass, she has always enjoyed getting a reaction out of [url=/c148150]you[/url]. Beneath the teasing is someone who has often taken your side, even when neither of you could work out how to talk about what happened to [url=/c148155]father[/url].
